anomalies.description: The page logged a timed-out Telnyx WebSocket connection followed by socket error and close messages.
anomalies.evidence: Live browser console contained three errors involving wss://rtc.telnyx.com/ while the scanner page remained rendered.
anomalies.impact: May add unrelated console noise during scanner QA or affect shared calling functionality; no scanner impact was proven.

anomalies.description: The facility and hub selectors lacked accessible labels, names, and ids in the inspected DOM.
anomalies.evidence: Live DOM inspection returned null for name, id, and aria-label on both selectors.
anomalies.impact: Semantic automation must currently distinguish the selectors by position, which is less stable.

uncertainties: No barcode was entered or submitted because a scan could modify order or vendor-related business state.
The response bodies were not inspected, so the exact response field shapes for facilities and hubs were not proven.
No scanner-specific request was triggered; the endpoint and result behavior for a submitted barcode remain unverified.
Empty, malformed, unknown, duplicate, and multi-barcode validation behavior was not tested because submission safety could not be established.
Changing facility, hub, or Auto Submit state was avoided, so persistence behavior and downstream request behavior remain unverified.
No child result page, success state, error modal, or scan-history surface was reachable without submitting a barcode.
result.summary: ADM currently exposes Scan | As Vendor at /scanner/as-driver through the Main navigation. The page provides a Barcode Numbers input and an Auto Submit on Scan radio setting that was On when observed. Facility and hub context were both selected as Hawaii, with live requests loading facilities and facility-specific hubs. No barcode was submitted and no business data was mutated.
